newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-BECKER OFFERS TO PLAY DAVIS CUP IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER OFFERS TO PLAY DAVIS CUP IN 1998.

text.p: Boris Becker said on Wednesday that he would make himself available to play for Germany in the Davis Cup next year.

Former world number one Becker, who made his final appearance at Wimbledon this year and should appear for the last time in a Grand Slam event at the forthcoming U.S. Open, said he would be available for the sport's premier team competition in 1998.
"I'll plan my schedule in order to be fit for Davis Cup matches," said Becker after beating Moroccan Karim Alami in straight sets at the Stuttgart clay court tournament.
The 29-year-old Becker said recently that he had a few months of competitive tennis ahead of him and would then start a new career as a coach.
